title: Super Supportive · Episode 4: Waiting After the Game
description: At eleven, Alden waits for Aunt Connie after baseball. Love and reliability turn out to be different things.

teaser.videoPrompt: Animate the supplied illustration in one continuous six-second shot. Preserve layered torn-paper collage and opaque gouache. Eleven-year-old Alden stands at the empty baseball dugout and looks to his unseen coach on the right. He speaks with quiet defensive concern, a tiny glance down afterward. Hands stay in his pockets; no walking or new characters. Preserve face, age, hair, clothing, location and medium exactly. Only Alden speaks, a natural quiet young boy voice. ENTIRE SPOKEN SCRIPT, in clear ENGLISH exactly once: "You don't have to wait.". Speak only these words between 0.5 and 3 seconds with synchronized lips, then mouth stays closed for the rest. No extra words, repetition, paraphrase, filler, humming, singing, narration or other voices. Very soft environmental ambience below foreground speech. No cuts, extra props, flashy effects or captions. One restrained emotional beat.
